rule_policy.json_schema: Portable structural constraints plus selected cross-field constraints that JSON Schema 2020-12 can express safely.
rule_policy.semantic_engine: Stable rule ids for cross-record, referential, ordering, and graph invariants. Critical portable rules may be checked here too so callers receive a stable rule id.

rules.description: Non-synthetic evidence must provide at least one DOI, PMID, accession, or URL.
Intervention order values must be unique.
Interventions must be serialized in ascending order.
Every evidence_ids entry must resolve to declared evidence.
Checksum algorithm is sha256 in contract 0.1.0.
SHA-256 digest is exactly 64 hexadecimal characters.
Source ids are unique within a release.
Artifact ids are unique within a release.
Every artifact source_id resolves to a declared source.
Artifact source_version matches the source snapshot version.
Derivation source_record_id matches its source artifact.
Episode reference schema versions match the release.
Episode ids are unique across release derivations.
